thread:
Nora: Quick QA round for Optimize toolkit docs. Found three small items: inconsistent cache header name across SDK snippets, a missing example for quant fallback, and the docs CI doesn't check /optimize URLs. Can we divvy up?
Rafael: I can do header consistency. Which header did we standardize on? x-rw-cache? x-cache-hit?
Nora: We decided on `x-rw-cache-hit` in the API spec. Docs had `x-cache-hit` in one Python snippet.
Priya: I'll update the Python snippet to show a short fallback to fp16 when quant fallback fires. Prefer a minimal example that fits in the page.
Ben: I'll add a tiny mkdocs health check in docs CI to hit /optimize/batching-and-caching and /optimize/quant-profiles and fail if 404. Simple curl + exit code.
Olivia: I'll comb the JS snippets and make sure they log the same header name. Also will add a one-line note about metric collection after cache misses.
docs-ci-bot: New issue opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/issues/2127 (label: docs/ci-test).
Rafael: For the header change I'll grep the repo and push a find/replace and short changelog entry.
Priya: Draft of Python snippet: ```python
resp = client.generate(model='open-opt-6b', prompt='Explain X', optimize={'cache_prefix': True})
if resp.headers.get('x-rw-cache-hit') == '1':
    print('cache hit')
else:
    # record latency metric, fallback example
    client.set_model('open-opt-6b-fp16')
    client.generate(model='open-opt-6b-fp16', prompt='Explain X')
```
Is that concise enough?
Nora: Yes please keep it under 8 lines. Also add a one-line caption: "Fallback example: swap to fp16 variant on quant regression".
Ben: For CI I'll add docs-ci job `check-optimize-pages` that curls both pages with a 5s timeout. Should be non-flaky. I'll include it behind a boolean so teams can enable if they want stricter validation.
Olivia: Small content question: should the quant profile example show per-channel vs per-tensor? I think one conservative example is enough.
Priya: I'll show both briefly: conservative per-channel and a compact per-tensor example with notes.
Rafael: Pushing header fixes now and linking the PRs. Will tag reviewers.
Nora: Great. Timeline: aim to have PRs open today, then I will combine into a single docs PR for final review. Thanks! :rocket:
Ben: PR for CI check opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4812
Rafael: Repo changes pushed for header renames, creating PR 4813.
Priya: Snippet PR ready, pinging for review.
